method.damageTarget: Aligned, unarmored target; Wraith arcs at 240px, other weapons at 360px; incoming attacks disabled only for weapon measurement.
method.pilot: All three hulls, normal collision/damage/movement, no health or damage overrides. Aware policy makes four decisions/sec from visible threat state. Each boss phase starts independently; one deterministic seed, 162 trials. This is a regression benchmark, not a claim of human difficulty or studio playtesting. The overdrive damage column measures active power, not its sustainable uptime.
